component.name: Cohort
component.summary: Power, battery, fan and keyboard settings for Lenovo Legion laptops

description.p: Cohort changes the settings Lenovo's own software changes on Windows, through the drivers Linux already has: power modes and custom power limits, battery conservation and rapid charging, always-on USB, Fn lock, fan curves, and the four-zone keyboard lighting.
Cohort is an independent project. It is not made, endorsed or supported by Lenovo.
